regime_context: The TSX narrative landscape is broad but non-directional with Big Banks as the clear leader (score 1.53 vs. challenger Pipelines 0.86, margin 0.67). No single narrative dominates (one_narrative=false). Absolute-trend gate is historically validated for drawdown control in Canada, so eligible themes carry a structural risk-management edge, but cross-sectional momentum ranks are a focus lens only and rotation timing is display-only. Crowding flags caution on banks, pipelines, O&G, and insurers.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities is one of the few eligible themes with a broad, uncrowded uptrend. The trend gate (validated risk control) supports its staying power, while high internal breadth (0.846) and moderate durability (0.65) suggest participation is healthy – not a speculative spike. Lack of crowding reduces immediate reflexivity risk, making it a defensive overweight vs. the TSX in a non-directional macro backdrop.
theses.dissent: As a defensive, rate-sensitive sector, Utilities could underperform if the macro narrative shifts to risk-on and bond yields spike sharply; trend may be mature with limited further upside.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO closes below its 40-day simple moving average OR the detector’s eligibility for Utilities flips to false (trend-gate break).

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Despite passing the trend gate, the Base Metals theme shows extremely narrow internal breadth (0.111) and low durability (0.47), indicating the trend is driven by a tiny subset of names. This fragile structure makes the eligible status unreliable; a low-breadth trend is more susceptible to reversal and underperformance relative to higher-quality trends in Canada.
theses.dissent: Concentrated supply-side catalysts (e.g., copper deficits) could lift all copper names irrespective of breadth, giving the theme outsized returns even on a weak internal structure.

falsifier.text: Breadth for 'Base Metals & Copper' (as measured by the detector) rises above 0.5 AND durability climbs above 0.6 within 20 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
